name: review-assigner
description: Rocket.Chat App that picks code reviewers from CODEOWNERS and load

scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run package
scripts.package: rm -rf .build && mkdir .build && cp -R app.json icon.png i18n ReviewAssignerApp.ts src package.json tsconfig.json .build/ && rm .build/src/core/fakes.ts && find .build/src -name '*.test.ts' -delete && ln -s ../node_modules .build/node_modules && (cd .build && rc-apps package) && mkdir -p dist && cp .build/dist/*.zip dist/
scripts.deploy: npm run package && cd .build && (rc-apps deploy --url $RC_URL --username $RC_USER --password $RC_PASS --update || rc-apps deploy --url $RC_URL --username $RC_USER --password $RC_PASS)
scripts.version: changeset version && node scripts/sync-app-version.mjs && prettier --write CHANGELOG.md package.json app.json

author: ricardogarim
